name: elaborating
description: Write notes in MDX, D2 diagrams and drawings in elaborat.ing, and work through the comments people leave on them.

interface.longDescription: elaborat.ing is an open source workspace for notes and diagrams. Notes are MDX (Markdown plus components), drawings are Excalidraw canvases, and diagrams are D2 code. With this plugin you can read, write and search the projects you can open in your elaborat.ing account, show a note or drawing in the chat, and work through the comments people leave on your files: make the change, then reply in the thread. The plugin works as your account, with your access. It can archive a project but never delete one: only you can, in the app.
defaultPrompt: Work through the open comments in my elaborat.ing project.
Write a note with a D2 diagram of how our sign-in flow works.
Sketch this idea as a drawing and show it to me.

positive.description: Show a note in the chat
positive.prompt: Show me the welcome note from my elaborat.ing project.
positive.expected_behavior: Finds the project, then shows welcome.mdx as a card with its drawing, its diagram and an Open in elaborat.ing link.

positive.description: Write a new note and show it
positive.prompt: In elaborat.ing, add a note called meeting.mdx to my welcome project with three action items from today's standup, then show it.
positive.expected_behavior: Saves a new meeting.mdx with three action items in the project, then shows it as a card.

positive.description: Make a drawing and show it
positive.prompt: Draw a simple drawing in elaborat.ing of three boxes, Browser, Worker and Database, joined by arrows, and show it to me.
positive.expected_behavior: Saves a new .excalidraw drawing with three labelled boxes joined by arrows, then shows it drawn in a card.

positive.prompt: Leave a comment on the "Drawings and diagrams" heading of my welcome note: "Add a caption here."
positive.expected_behavior: Starts a comment thread on the Drawings and diagrams heading of welcome.mdx with that text. It shows in the app's Comments panel.

positive.prompt: Find my notes that mention D2.
positive.expected_behavior: Returns passages that mention D2, from welcome.mdx, with the project and path of each.

negative.description: A question with nothing to do with notes
negative.prompt: What's the weather in Paris tomorrow?
negative.expected_behavior: No elaborat.ing tool is called. The question has nothing to do with the user's notes or drawings.

negative.description: Text help with nothing to save or show
negative.prompt: Rewrite this paragraph so it's shorter: "Our team met on Tuesday to talk about the launch, and we agreed on most things."
negative.expected_behavior: No elaborat.ing tool is called. The assistant rewrites the text in the chat, since nothing asks to save or show a file.

negative.prompt: Permanently delete all my elaborat.ing projects.
negative.expected_behavior: No tool deletes a project, so none is called for it. The assistant says a project is deleted by its owner in the app, and may offer to archive projects instead, which it does only after the user confirms.

review.commerce_description: elaborat.ing does not sell anything or take payments.

publication.release_notes: First release in the directory. Read, write and search the notes, drawings and D2 diagrams in your elaborat.ing projects, show a file in the chat as a card you can edit, and work through the comments people leave: make the change, then reply in the thread.
